text: If you've got outdoor plans stacked up today, keep them loose between 2 and 5 — that's the window forecasters are watching for a stray shower or rumble, and the European model actually thinks it's the wetter bet of the day, so don't be shocked if it's more than just hit-or-miss. Otherwise it's a mild, partly sunny Wednesday, high near 81, with a south breeze that swings west later. The lake's calm and pleasant if you get out before the afternoon risk builds, waves a foot or less, water still a swimmable 73. Showers linger into tonight before clearing out, low around 60. Thursday rebounds nicely, partly sunny and a touch cooler near 78, with dry, seasonable air holding right through the weekend. Air quality's good all around, so no worries there. My call: get your outdoor stuff done by early afternoon, and if you're on the water, plan to be off by 1 or so just in case that afternoon batch of showers rolls through.
